what: flatten_background's low_pct/high_pct percentile clip (shipped 0.5/99.5), swept on the 26 hand-labelled tiles and confirmed on full frames
figure6_justification_record: kwarg defaults on flatten_background; the docstring argues percentile over min/max and gives no numbers for either
not_swept_here: sigma, which is swept in ladder_endpoints.py and is not this file
affine_note: both downstream thresholds, Otsu and median - k*MAD, are affine-equivariant, so on an unclipped float residual this constant would have NO effect at all. Everything measured here comes from the two things the stretch does that an affine map does not: saturation at 0 and 255, and 8-bit quantisation.

dual_location_coupling.split: detector_overrides._flatten delegates to flatten_background for sigma <= DECIMATE_ABOVE_SIGMA (64) and uses its own hard-coded copy above it, so on SCALE_LADDER [5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 160, 320] the kwarg governs 4 of 7 rungs and the hard-coded copy governs 3
dual_location_coupling.measured: arms[*].coupling, in pixels, on the tiles

classifier_note: the tile arms run the SHIPPED chain, region classifier included, and the classifier's MeanDarkness and MeanVesselness features are read off `flat` -- which this constant rescales. So a non-shipped arm does not merely move a threshold, it also feeds models/crack_classifier.joblib an input scaled differently from the one it was fitted on. That is a real cost of changing the constant and it is deliberately left IN the final_* rows; the candidate_pooled_* rows are the same arms with the classifier removed, and are the classifier-free comparison. The frame half is candidate-stage only, so it carries none of this.
decimate_note: DECIMATE_ABOVE_SIGMA, the boundary that splits the clip across two files, is itself unmeasured -- Figure 6 records it as 'a speed guard in detector_overrides.py carrying no comment and no measurement'

frames.frame_selection: up to 2 per specimen, NOT alphabetical
frames.input: D.load_as_uint8 with common.contrast_kwargs_for(name), i.e. the shipped contrast window including its three hand overrides
frames.scoring: correction masks: 1 = crack, 2 or 3 = not-crack, 0 excluded
frames.stage: candidate stage (clean_mask min 13 px, then components >= 40 px); the region classifier is NOT applied here, matching ladder_endpoints_frames.py

controls.reconstruction_at_0.5_99.5_equals_shippe: PASS, bit-identical on all 15 frames scored

frames.arm_selection: shipped, raw min/max, a fixed bracket, plus the tiles' pooled argmax and LOSO modal pick -- chosen by the tile half, not after seeing frame scores
